sources.snippet: MCP-Universe: Benchmarking Large Language Models with Real-World Model Context Protocol Servers MCP-Universe is a comprehensive framework designed for developing, testing, and benchmarking AI agents. It offers a robust platform for building and evaluating both AI agents and LLMs across a wide range of task environments. The framework also supports seamless integration with external MCP servers ...

sources.snippet: Universal DB MCP Connect AI to Your Database with Natural Language A universal database connector implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and HTTP API, enabling AI assistants to query and analyze your databases using natural language. Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, ChatGPT, and 50+ other platforms.
